{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>premiere_ref2_m</code>). Its card pool is the same as [[Premiere - Reflections II]], Decipher set ids 1&ndash;10 and premium ids 101&ndash;112, with two cards banned: ''[[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]'' and ''[[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]''.<ref name="gemp" /> Forum threads call it "P-Reflections II (w/ WYS and AOBS banned)".<ref name="t82167" /><ref name="t84007" />
